description: Three targeted, low-risk frontend improvements to Public/frontend-v6 that raise PWABuilder/Lighthouse scores against findings audited on the live site, plus test updates. (1) Best Practices / console error: allow Cloudflare Web Analytics in the CSP. (2) SEO + Accessibility: add exactly one semantic <h1> to the home route for the default (premium) skin, which currently renders zero h1s. (3) SEO / social: strengthen og:title/twitter:title and upgrade the social preview image/card. Depends on FEAT-001 (green baseline).
steps: CSP (Best Practices / console error): In Public/frontend-v6/vercel.json, edit ONLY the Content-Security-Policy header VALUE (the last headers block, source '/(.*)'). Add https://static.cloudflareinsights.com to the script-src directive, and add https://cloudflareinsights.com to the connect-src directive. Keep every other directive and existing origin EXACTLY as-is (default-src 'self'; style-src fonts.googleapis; font-src fonts.gstatic; img-src lh3.googleusercontent/drive/drive.usercontent/files-chhath; connect-src's existing chhath-public-worker + chhath-server-render; manifest-src, worker-src, frame-ancestors, base-uri, form-action, object-src). Result must remain a single valid CSP string. Do NOT add any non-schema keys (no 'comment' key) — that previously broke the Vercel schema.

H1 (SEO + A11y): In Public/frontend-v6/src/lib/skins/premium/pages/Home.svelte, add exactly one

so the default skin's home route has a top-level heading (it currently has none — this is the h1Count:0 the live audit saw). Match the pattern already used by the aurora/classic/festival Home.svelte:

{$tr('app_title')}

. Import the tr store the same way those skins do (import { tr } from '$lib/stores/lang';). Place it at the top of the rendered content (e.g. just inside the {:else} branch before , or above the {#if} block) so it renders on both the loading and ready branches. Do NOT change HeroBanner.svelte (it is shared only by premium but keeping it as

avoids any visual change). Ensure the home route ends up with EXACTLY ONE h1 for premium (and confirm the other four skins still have exactly one each — do not touch them).

OG title (SEO / social): In Public/frontend-v6/src/lib/components/Seo.svelte, the `title` derived value resolves to just $tr('app_title') ('Chhath Puja') for the home path, and og:title/twitter:title reuse it — this is the weak social title. Introduce a stronger social title for the social meta tags while keeping the document <title> behavior unchanged. Use the full descriptive title consistent with the document title: build it as `${$tr('app_title')} ${'\u2014'} Navyuvak Chhath Puja Samiti` OR reuse the existing full string 'Chhath Puja Transparency Portal — Navyuvak Chhath Puja Samiti'. Prefer deriving from i18n where possible; a new i18n key (e.g. app_title_full / social_title) added to BOTH the en and hi blocks of src/lib/i18n.ts is acceptable if it keeps things translatable — otherwise use the app_title + samiti-name composition. Apply this social title to og:title and twitter:title only for the home route; inner routes already get a descriptive `${title} — ${app_title}` and should keep that. Keep the change consistent with Seo.svelte's existing $derived structure.

OG image + card (SEO / social): In Seo.svelte, point og:image and twitter:image at ${config.siteUrl}/screenshots/wide.png (the existing 1280x720 asset in static/screenshots/wide.png, which satisfies the >=1200x630 recommendation) instead of /icons/icon-512.png. Add/adjust the Twitter card type to summary_large_image (add <meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image" /> if not already emitted by Seo.svelte or app.html — check app.html first to avoid a duplicate; if app.html already sets twitter:card, update it there consistently or move it into Seo.svelte, keeping exactly one twitter:card tag). Do NOT fabricate any new image asset; only reference wide.png which already exists.

Tests: Update Public/frontend-v6/src/lib/seo.test.ts to reflect the new social title and image/card. Specifically: (a) keep the existing assertion that Seo.svelte emits og:title/twitter:title/og:url/og:description/twitter:title/name=description; (b) add an assertion that Seo.svelte references screenshots/wide.png for og:image/twitter:image (no longer icon-512.png for the social image); (c) add an assertion that a summary_large_image twitter:card is present exactly once across app.html + Seo.svelte; (d) if a new i18n key was added, assert it exists in both en and hi blocks of i18n.ts. Add a test that the premium home route has exactly one <h1>: read src/lib/skins/premium/pages/Home.svelte and assert it contains exactly one <h1 occurrence; optionally assert each skin's pages/Home.svelte contains exactly one <h1. Add a test that vercel.json's CSP includes https://static.cloudflareinsights.com in script-src and https://cloudflareinsights.com in connect-src, and that the CSP is still one string with default-src 'self' and object-src 'none' intact. Follow the existing describe/it style in seo.test.ts (Node fs reads of source files).

Rebuild and verify no unintended output changes: run npm run build; diff build/manifest.webmanifest against /tmp/manifest.baseline.webmanifest (must be identical); confirm the built response headers config still carries the CSP with cloudflareinsights (vercel.json is the source; also confirm total client JS bytes <= 700000 and did not increase meaningfully).
acceptance_criteria: vercel.json CSP script-src contains https://static.cloudflareinsights.com and connect-src contains https://cloudflareinsights.com; all other directives/origins unchanged; CSP remains a single valid string; no non-schema keys added to vercel.json.
src/lib/skins/premium/pages/Home.svelte renders exactly one <h1> on the home route; each of the five skins' home route renders exactly one <h1> (no zero, no duplicates).
Seo.svelte og:title and twitter:title for the home route use the full descriptive title (not the bare 'Chhath Puja').
Seo.svelte og:image and twitter:image reference /screenshots/wide.png; a single twitter:card=summary_large_image is present.
npm run check reports 0 errors / 0 warnings.
npm test passes, including updated/added assertions in seo.test.ts.
npm run build succeeds; build/manifest.webmanifest is byte-identical to the baseline; total client JS <= 700000 bytes.
verification: cd Public/frontend-v6 && export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH" && npm run check && npm test && npm run build
findings:
Implemented all three PWA/Lighthouse fixes + tests, scoped to Public/frontend-v6 only. Changes: (1) vercel.json — added https://static.cloudflareinsights.com to script-src and https://cloudflareinsights.com to connect-src of the CSP header value for source '/(.*)'; every other directive/origin left byte-for-byte identical; CSP remains a single valid string; no non-schema keys added. (2) src/lib/skins/premium/pages/Home.svelte — added `import { tr } from '$lib/stores/lang';` and one `

{$tr('app_title')}

` above the {#if $portalState.failed} block so it renders on both failed and ready branches; all five skins now have exactly one home h1 (aurora/classic/festival/slate untouched). (3) src/lib/components/Seo.svelte — added a `socialTitle` derived that uses new i18n key `social_title` for the home route (meta.path===''), falling back to the existing `title` for inner routes; og:title and twitter:title now use socialTitle; og:image/twitter:image now point at ${config.siteUrl}/screenshots/wide.png (existing 1280x720 asset) instead of /icons/icon-512.png. (4) src/lib/i18n.ts — added social_title to BOTH en ('Chhath Puja Transparency Portal — Navyuvak Chhath Puja Samiti') and hi ('छठ पूजा पारदर्शिता पोर्टल — नवयुवक छठ पूजा समिति') blocks. (5) src/app.html — changed the single twitter:card from 'summary' to 'summary_large_image' (kept as single source of truth; Seo.svelte does NOT emit a duplicate twitter:card). (6) src/lib/seo.test.ts — added assertions: Seo references screenshots/wide.png and not icon-512.png for the social image; exactly one summary_large_image twitter:card across app.html+Seo.svelte; home social title uses socialTitle/social_title; social_title present in both en+hi; premium home has exactly one

; each of five skins' home has exactly one

; vercel.json CSP has both cloudflareinsights origins in script-src/connect-src with default-src 'self' and object-src 'none' intact and no 'comment' key. (7) src/lib/a11y/structure-and-motion.test.ts — corrected the pre-existing h1 heuristic that falsely treated DecadeBanner as an h1 provider (DecadeBanner renders NO h1, verified); removed the DecadeBanner clause from both the 'not missing' and 'no two' checks so premium's new real h1 is not double-counted. No page relies on DecadeBanner for its h1 (verified via scan). VERIFICATION (from Public/frontend-v6, nvm PATH): npm run check = 0 errors / 0 warnings; npm test = 295 passed across 16 files (baseline 286; +9 new); npm run build succeeded; total client JS = 622175 bytes <= 700000 budget (baseline 621798, delta +377, no new deps); build/manifest.webmanifest sha256 = 46731fcf3c1c3506d6a9919ec32592211f1d11adcf22fb750385bdf7063d34da (byte-identical to manifest.baseline.webmanifest); grep confirms both https://static.cloudflareinsights.com and https://cloudflareinsights.com present in vercel.json CSP. NOTE: verification step referenced /tmp/manifest.baseline.webmanifest but /tmp does not persist; used the durable baseline copy's sha256 instead (matches). No commit/push/PR performed per instructions — working-tree changes left in place. DEVIATION FROM SPEC: also edited src/lib/a11y/structure-and-motion.test.ts (not in the original relevant_files list) because its h1-count heuristic double-counted premium's new h1 via an inaccurate DecadeBanner assumption; the fix aligns the heuristic with reality and keeps all tests green.
